description: Cipher learning, Focus combat ownership, Reaping Knives and progression in the real engine on BG2EE/ToB including campaign-legal high levels.
prerequisites: Disposable legal fixture with Cipher, the read-only checkpoint helper and two legally created Cipher actors.
Controlled hostile and friendly targets with normal hits, critical hits and misses observed in real combat.
Ordinary rest, inn rental and temple healing access, a second area and local saves; XP grants only prepare real level-up screens.
Independent installed-rule oracles for Focus gain/cap/cost, learning credits, tier unlocks and Reaping Knives ownership/expiry.
Before preparation, hash and read installed XPCAP and XPLEVEL rows; derive attainable levels from those resources. Controlled XP may reach the installed cap but must not change or bypass it.

Real BG2EE data with ToB available for high-level preparation; record the active campaign and preserve legally created actors. Low/middle checkpoints may resume genuine campaign-start or imported lower-level saves; never overwrite component/class levels.
Fresh legally created Base Cipher and Soul Blade actors, plus a non-Cipher control; independent installed subclass, Focus-gain/cap and power-cost resources are retained with hashes.
instructions: Record starting Focus and before/after Focus for hostile normal/critical hits, misses and friendly attacks; reach the cap and attempt further gain.
Exercise power learning confirm/cancel, casting/spending, target cancellation and quickslot casting through the actual UI.
Use two Ciphers to check Reaping Knives credit owner, transfer, expiry and save/reload without cross-credit. Record both actors' Focus and the recipient/owner state.
Use real low/middle/high level-up screens; independently verify new tier credits and eligibility at levels 16 and 19.

Exercise actual inn room selection and rental confirmation for cipher.rest.inn; derive restored spell charges and any pool reset from installed rules. Temple healing is a separate store purchase, not rest: record native cure identity/effects, expected HP healing and unchanged known spells and Focus in cipher.temple-healing. Capture before/after values and native store UI actions; never invoke the store callbacks directly.
Compare observed Focus/powers after ordinary rest, inn rental, an area transition and save/reload with the documented reset/persistence rules. Quit normally.

Select Base Cipher and Soul Blade through the real selector, cancel before committing and compare unchanged identity/resources, then commit and verify persistent subclass identity after ordinary save/reload, quicksave/reload, area travel and rest.

Compare both subclasses and the non-Cipher control: normal hostile hits grant Base 5 and Soul Blade 10 Focus, critical hits 10 and 20, misses/friendly attacks no gain; neither gain nor spend may affect the non-Cipher. Derive these expectations independently from installed resources.

Exercise Soul Blade power and quickslot casting, checking its additional 5 Focus cost, target cancellation without spending, and cap behavior against 20 + 5 * min(level, 30). Observe overflow clipping and, where legally reachable, the 165-to-170 final partial gain; BGEE records its campaign-cap boundary and rejects unattainable higher tiers.
